source: Bybit V5 public market API + public WebSocket / linear perpetual

notes.long_short_ratio: Bybit long/short account-holder ratio, not position-size ratio.
notes.trade_flow: 15m aggressive taker flow from publicTrade; delta = taker Buy turnover - taker Sell turnover.
notes.cvd: CVD fields are cumulative from the beginning of the requested/report range, not an exchange-provided absolute CVD.
notes.liquidations: 15m allLiquidation aggregation. S=Buy is counted as long liquidation; S=Sell as short liquidation per Bybit documentation.
notes.flow_history: WebSocket-derived flow/liquidations begin when this collector version starts; earlier history is intentionally absent.
